title: Use the OutboxEntityKind.track constant instead of the 'track' string literal in two_device_sync_test.dart:109
why: The file already imports outbox_processor.dart and uses the named OutboxEntityKind.completion constant at line 70, but line 109 hardcodes 'track' instead of the already-available OutboxEntityKind.track. The value happens to match today, but the constant exists precisely so a future rename of the underlying string doesn't silently desync a call site like this one.
acceptance_criteria: learning_tracker/test/sync/two_device_sync_test.dart:109 reads OutboxEntityKind.track instead of the string literal 'track'.
